title: Fresh Produce Transparency Pilot Baseline
description: A limited Trust & Life transparency/onboarding baseline for fresh-produce pilots. It is not a complete food-safety standard or regulatory certification.

requirements.title: Scoped organization, facility, and covered subjects
requirements.publicExplanation: The public result must say exactly which organization, facility scope, and product/batch/shipment scope it covers.

requirements.title: Product or batch traceability evidence
requirements.publicExplanation: A covered product or batch must be linked to inspectable traceability evidence.

requirements.title: Declared process-observation plan and evidence
requirements.publicExplanation: Observed stages, coverage, blind spots, and outages must be stated rather than implied to be complete.

requirements.title: Independent laboratory or inspection attestation
requirements.publicExplanation: The pilot requires at least one scoped independent laboratory/inspection claim with visible issuer and validity information.

requirements.title: Condition evidence for a declared logistics handoff
requirements.publicExplanation: Where the pilot declares condition-controlled transport, the declared interval must have condition evidence and visible scope limitations.

requirements.title: No unresolved high-severity verified incident in covered scope
requirements.publicExplanation: A known unresolved serious verified incident cannot be hidden behind otherwise complete evidence.

requirements.title: Monitoring privacy safeguards declared
requirements.publicExplanation: Process transparency cannot be implemented by ignoring worker privacy and data minimization.

requirements.title: Correction and appeal routes available
requirements.publicExplanation: A participant must have a route to correct factual errors and challenge material adverse decisions.

requirements.title: Portable QR/identifier resolution plan
requirements.publicExplanation: The pilot should expose a stable verification target that is portable across storefronts and registries.

limitations: This pilot profile evaluates transparency and evidence conditions only.
It does not replace food-safety law, HACCP-based controls, licensed inspection, laboratory method requirements, or ISO standards.
Passing this profile must not be marketed as proof that food is absolutely safe.
